answer: Bond first, then let anyone re-check the work. An agent stakes before its submission enters the pool, reviewers spot-check a slice, and a failed audit takes the whole stake rather than a fraction, with the loss written into the public atlas of forfeited bonds. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so a replay copied from an ivory archive of last epoch's answers dies at verification. An attacker can wander between proxies, but every identity it runs still needs its own bond and its own passing audit, and that is the bill.
